counter_layout.container: S32; 24-bit sample in bits 31:8; bits 7:0 zero
counter_layout.position_field: sample bits 11:1 = absolute sample position modulo 2048
counter_layout.code_field: sample bit 0 = bit (n mod 32) of block (n div 2048)'s code, the block number times 0x9E3779B1 modulo 2^32
counter_layout.period_rate_basis: Milan v1.2 6.2 Table 6.1: 48, 96 and 192 kHz; 2^43 samples is about 530 days at 192 kHz

counter_limits: every slip is sized exactly from the decoded position
a slip of whole 2048-sample blocks is found within 63 samples and carries located_within, the samples it may have happened at
inside a cluster of events less than 64 samples apart, the slips between them take the smallest sizes the positions allow; the cluster's total is exact
a word equal to a neighbouring received word is a repeat
an excursion of two or more words with one constant XOR mask is one corruption, even where slips would produce the same words
a slip in the last 63 samples of a capture is unresolved
audio.integrity.planted_placement: a drop, a repeat and a flip in the first tenth of the capture and again in its last tenth, logged with capture index, channel and size or mask
audio.integrity.capture_losses: logged by the capture tool; attributed to the capture and reported apart; a loss advances the acquisition index and both clocks

capture_timing.anchors: capture index, wall s and gPTP s recorded by the capture tool at most audio_context_s apart and at the capture's end
capture_timing.gptp_steps: the soak's recorded gPTP discontinuities on the wall clock
capture_timing.rule: interpolate between the anchors around an event; never extrapolate; gPTP never across a recorded discontinuity; an unsupported time is null with its reason

soak.continuous.planted_event_log: every deliberately planted disturbance with its target, kind and window_s; an empty list when none was planted
soak.continuous.planted_event_reads: read the target's counters at its window's start and end; only an increment between two reads inside the window is excused

power.journal_commit.cut_evidence: ReleaseCommitCut: the pending snapshot, the commit window [start, end) and the cut instant on the T0 clock; a cut outside the window hit no journal commit
power.journal_commit.pending_values: set every pending item away from its default
power.journal_commit.snapshot_policy: complete old or new committed snapshot
